response.text: {"question":"What limits are placed on a Chief Risk Officer's involvement in the credit sanction process for high‑value loans at a public sector bank?","answer":"The CRO may only act as an adviser and have no voting rights when the bank does not use a committee approach, and if the bank uses a committee, the CRO can be a decision‑maker with voting power only if all committee members accept joint liability; otherwise the CRO must remain an adviser without voting rights.","answerable":true}
